Network Service Resource Delete Custom Network Service
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkServices/:serviceId

Deletes the network service for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
serviceId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the network service.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
